description: ocsp.rs line 108: .find(|r| &r.cert_id.serial_number == cert_serial). CertID in RFC 6960 §4.1.1 contains issuerNameHash and issuerKeyHash in addition to serialNumber. Matching only on serialNumber means an OCSP response for a certificate from a different CA with the same serial number will match. Serial number uniqueness is only guaranteed within a single CA's issuance, not globally. An attacker who can obtain a valid OCSP 'good' response for cert X from CA-A can use it to satisfy revocation checking for cert Y from CA-B if X and Y share a serial number. This is acknowledged in the Limitations rustdoc but it is a security defect in the matching logic.
title: OcspChecker matches SingleResponse by serial number only, ignoring issuer hashes
